campuses.text: Main campus in downtown Montreal, the creative and cultural capital of Canada, offering fashion, design, culinary, gaming, and hospitality programs.

paragraphs: LaSalle College is a private post-secondary institution in Montreal, Quebec, offering creative, design, culinary, hospitality, and technology programs. Founded in 1959, LaSalle is one of Canada's leading colleges for fashion design, interior design, graphic design, culinary arts, and video game development.

The college has campuses in Montreal and an international network, with partner schools across Latin America, Asia, and Africa. LaSalle's programs combine creative theory with hands-on studio work, industry projects, and professional development, preparing graduates for careers in competitive creative industries.

Montreal is Canada's cultural capital — a world-renowned centre for design, fashion, gaming, and culinary arts. International students benefit from an affordable, cosmopolitan city with a strong creative economy and bilingual French-English environment.

Graduates of eligible programs at LaSalle College qualify for the Post-Graduation Work Permit and can pursue pathways to Canadian permanent residency. Montreal's growing technology and creative industries provide strong employment prospects for international graduates.
paragraphsRu: LaSalle College — частное учебное заведение в Монреале, Квебек, предлагающее творческие, дизайнерские, кулинарные, гостиничные и технологические программы. Основан в 1959 году.
Колледж имеет кампусы в Монреале и международную сеть партнёрских школ. Программы LaSalle сочетают творческую теорию с практической студийной работой и отраслевыми проектами.
Монреаль — культурная столица Канады, всемирно известный центр дизайна, моды, гейминга и кулинарного искусства.
Выпускники соответствующих программ LaSalle College получают право на Post-Graduation Work Permit.
